sections.presenting_complaint: Vomiting and diarrhoea in a 10-month-old since last night.
sections.history: About five bile-stained, green vomits since last night, fewer today. Six to seven loose stools today. Blood in stool. Brother had similar illness from nursery; Freya attends the same nursery. Four wet nappies since this morning. Taking small amounts of breast milk and formula. Temperature 37.4 °C. Alert and playing. Not drowsy or floppy. No rash. Previously well.
sections.medications_allergies: No regular medications. No known drug allergies.
sections.impression: Probable viral gastroenteritis with reduced urine output.
sections.plan: Face-to-face assessment at the surgery today at 16:00. Continue breastfeeding; oral rehydration solution in small, frequent amounts.
sections.safety_netting: Call 999 if floppy, very sleepy, hard to wake, or non-blanching rash. Attend A&E if green vomit or blood in stool.
